old_caption: The video captures a mechanical press in action, applying pressure to a stack of wooden planks. The press, a large metallic cylinder, is static above the wooden stack, which is secured on a black and yellow striped base. The wood shows visible compression and deformation. The surrounding environment includes safety barriers marked with yellow and black stripes, indicating a controlled industrial setting. The background is a plain, light-colored wall, keeping the focus on the mechanical setup. The video emphasizes the process of the wooden stack being compressed under the press, highlighting the power and precision of the mechanical press.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a mechanical press in action, applying pressure to a stack of wooden planks. The press, a large metallic cylinder, descends steadily onto the wooden stack, which is secured on a black and yellow striped base. As the press continues its descent, the wood begins to compress, showing signs of deformation under the increasing force. The surrounding environment includes safety barriers marked with yellow and black stripes, indicating a controlled industrial setting. A control panel with buttons and a digital display is visible on the left side of the frame, suggesting manual operation of the press. The background is a plain, light-colored wall, keeping the focus on the mechanical process. The video emphasizes the transformation of the wooden stack as it is compressed, highlighting the power and precision of the mechanical press.
caption: The video captures a hydraulic press head bearing down on a vertical stack of light-colored wooden planks wrapped in clear plastic film. The planks rest on a cylindrical base painted with yellow-and-black hazard stripes. A gray machine frame flanked by striped safety columns and a small action camera on the left surrounds the pressing zone. As the excerpt unfolds, the large metallic head descends steadily, its lower rim sinking into the top of the stack while the bottom layers remain seated on the base. The overall height of the stack visibly shrinks, the individual boards pressing closer together. The protruding plank on the left side holds roughly its position as the layers above it settle, and the plastic wrap on the right shifts and crinkles. The surrounding frame, columns, and base stay fixed, keeping the view a steady close-up on the compressing wood.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
